title: The engine gets ready for a second game
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: Ahead of racing, a game can now end a match as "finished" when its own goal is reached, and replays can name their game and its rules version. A replay for another game, or from older rules, is refused with a plain message.

Tank Arena keeps writing exactly the files it wrote before: every pinned hash, replay, parity fixture and the evolution champion are unchanged. Speed is the same within noise, and the browser build is about 2% larger.
next: Blitzwing's racing rules, which plug into these.
